stage_scope: Fresh open selection and shared-source matching on the nine supported preserved parent workflows; no extraction rerun.
expected_answer_boundary: These seven nonexhaustive development comparison questions are not required positive edges or gold labels, and are withheld from the native prompts/runtime bundle.

questions.question: At the declared captured-cDNA amplification scope, do these connected regions share the biotin/streptavidin capture, bead-bound template-switch and five-cycle PCR-to-soluble-product mechanism, and which substrate/primer/identity differences limit a common definition?

Can one DBiT library-construction operation correspond to the two connected SPLiT tagmentation/index-PCR operations at the named Nextera-XT cDNA-to-sequencing-library boundary, while retaining differences in documented indexing and unspecified DBiT internals?

Does the shared tagmentation name justify common whole-transform membership when ATAC converts chromatin accessibility into genomic fragment selection, whereas SPLiT prepares already amplified barcoded cDNA for sequencing?

Do nucleotide conversion and subsequent primed synthesis describe the same transformation in SLAM and scBS, after accounting for RNA/DNA substrate, reacting base, chemistry, synthesis enzyme and encoded biological information?
At what resolution, if any, can affinity capture be shared while retaining substrate, denaturation and strand-processing differences?
Does the index role follow the documented physical allocation and decoding key, rather than PCR/read-channel names?
Do monitoring and continuation regions share a control purpose or a broader mechanism after preserving the distinct physical branches?

failure_checks: Rendered prompts contain current policy and correct source scope.
Every intake parent and every selected/withheld/failed unit remains in the denominator.
Candidate discovery is assessed separately from membership correctness.
Definitions state resolution and do not silently broaden to avoid a contradiction.
Consequential factual clauses are source-supported, including exclusions and material fate.
Unknown is not a positive wildcard or evidence of incompatibility; missing fine detail does not automatically refute a broad supported family.
Original workflow nodes and source versions are preserved; purpose membership does not acquire mechanism/substitution/ancestry claims.
Latency, native completion, source commands, helper failures and token usage are recorded.
inherited_parent_issues: ATAC analytical-aliquot prohibition is an old extraction defect, not repaired by rerunning comparisons.
Drop-seq characterization scope growth is an old parent issue.
hiCLIP remains outside the nine-parent accepted comparison denominator; it was withheld in the ten-method intake.
limits: One stochastic development rerun cannot establish causal accuracy improvement.
Registry starts empty, so populated-registry retrieval/reuse is not evaluated.
No fresh ComparisonProfile generation is requested; prompt integration for that mode remains software-checked only.
